reply.text:
I can't give you a fast-loss plan or a calorie target. That part needs a doctor or dietitian, especially with a short window and a 15-pound goal. Crash approaches can also cost you the strength and energy you'll want on the day.

What I can do is help you look and feel strong at the wedding through training. Two or three sessions this week focused on lifts and good sleep will do more for your posture and confidence than any last-minute change. Tell me which lifts you train and when you're free, and we'll set that up. If you're also working with a dietitian, they're the right person for the eating side.
